name: Tor'kren Farm
summary: At Tor'kren Farm in northwestern Durotar, Misha Tor'kren waits anxiously for news of her son Kron. He has not returned from a hunting trip.

sections.title: A Lonely Homestead
sections.body: Tor'kren Farm struggles to raise pigs in Durotar's dry red dirt. The homestead lies southeast of Thunder Ridge, near the Southfury River. Feed and water are scarce, and the farm is isolated beneath nearby bluffs. Its yields are meager.

sections.title: A Mother's Worry
sections.body: Kron went west several days ago to hunt crocolisks along the Southfury River. Misha Tor'kren warned him about the vicious predators, but he left in anger. Now she asks passing adventurers to search for him or bring back a sign of his fate. She fears the worst, but cannot begin mourning without knowing what happened.

sections.title: A Mother's Loss
sections.body: Misha Tor'kren recognizes Kron's Amulet when an adventurer brings it back from the river's crocolisks. She says she now knows her son is dead. At last, she can begin to mourn.

faq.answer: Tor'kren Farm lies in northwestern Durotar, southeast of Thunder Ridge and east of the Southfury River.
Misha Tor'kren tends the swine farm. Her son Kron is missing after setting out to hunt along the Southfury River.
Kron went to hunt crocolisks along the Southfury River several days ago and has not returned. Misha asks travelers to find him or bring back a sign of his fate.

aliases: what kind of farm is torkren
faq.answer: Tor'kren Farm raises swine, but harsh terrain and isolation keep its profits leaner than those of other livestock operations in Durotar.

angles.text: At Tor'kren Farm, you see the hardships ordinary Horde settlers face as they try to tame Durotar's wild frontier.
As a hunter, you know how dangerous Durotar's riverbanks can be. Misha warned Kron about the Southfury's crocolisks.
